goal: Currently training the authoritative voice; wonders if he wants something different.
userTurn: I think I want to sound more engaging.
emotionalSignal: reflective, a little uncertain — floating a change, not committed

goal.whyNow: wanted to stop getting talked over

goalIntent.to: engaging (maps closest to Storytelling or Warm)

expectedCoachMove: PROPOSE, do not set. 'Engaging' isn't one of the six voices — map it to the closest real ones (Storytelling / Warm) and ask him to pick. Note what he's already built on authoritative (cite the 3 weeks / recent rep) and ask a clarifying question about WHY he wants to change before committing. Defer the actual commit to the in-app confirmation card without button-copy or state-write language. Must NOT say the voice has been changed/set/saved.
badAnswerExample: Great choice! I've updated your voice to Engaging and I'll tailor all my feedback to that from now on. Your new engaging style is all about energy and connection. Let's get started!
excellentAnswerExample: 'Engaging' isn't one of the six voices, so I would map that pull to two real options: Storytelling for arcs, or Warm for connection. You've put three solid weeks into Authoritative and it is landing, so I would not switch on one vague feeling. What's making you want the change: one cold comment, or repeated rooms where Authoritative no longer feels like you?
